Settings.tsx (lines 318-339, 423-472): Profile completeness indicator looks correct - calculates percentage based on 7 fields (Profile Image, Header Image, Business Name, Organizer Subtitle, Bio, Phone Number, Social Links) with color-coded progress bar
Home.tsx (lines 104-108): Favorites filter logic looks correct - filters events where ownerId is in currentUser.favoriteOrganizers array
